build_tldr_preference_dataset: build a preference dataset from openai/summarize_from_feedback for TL;DR summarization tasks
run_tldr_preference_script: run the tldr_preference script to transform and push a preference dataset to the Hugging Face Hub
test_to_preference_function: test the to_preference function that converts feedback examples into prompt, chosen, and rejected fields
summarize_script_arguments: summarize the ScriptArguments dataclass with push_to_hub, repo_id, and dataset_num_proc fields
review_model_card: review the ModelCard metadata for the TL;DR preference dataset generated by this script
